Welcome to the spine of MIAO-GTNH: seven age milestones from steam all the way to LuV. The steam age is about your first machines, squeezing more from every ore, and trading bronze muscle for steel discipline.

Two rules from the tutorial still save bases here: boilers only drink water fed from the §6bottom§r, and §cnever add water to a dry, hot boiler — it explodes§r. Steam exits from the sides.

Our recommended route bolts GT Steam Reborn onto the backbone: hub array early, cache nodes everywhere, multiblocks doing the heavy lifting.
